description: Every way to earn on Hyperliquid / HyperEVM, ranked in one table: liquid staking tokens (kHYPE, stHYPE, beHYPE), lending markets with supply and borrow rates, utilisation and max LTV, and LP or looping pools. Separates yield a pool earns from yield paid in emitted tokens, and anchors everything against what the network itself pays for staking. Start here for "where is the best yield"; use hyperevm_pool_history to see whether one of these rates has held. Read-only, public data, no API key.

category.description: lst = liquid staking, lending = money markets, other = LP/looping/PT, all = everything (default)

min_tvl.description: Minimum pool TVL in USD. Default 1000000.
